accounting.rationale: Original physical PDF119, printed105, lines11-18 combines a definition, a qualified DATA permission, initial-value interpretation, one-initialization restriction and shape/order restriction. Fine dispositions keep the non-obligations separate from the three actual prose requirements.

The first sentence describes initialization in an entity-decl, not any executable assignment, component-initialization or procedure-pointer proc-decl. PENDING finite R803/R805 source-use of equals, null-init and initial-data-target with C806/C808/C811-C813; preserve those canonical owners.

The entity lacks PARAMETER. PENDING source-use contrast of INTEGER variable x=7 and named constant x=7 with PARAMETER in distinct scopes. The latter is governed by 8.5.13/8.6.11, not a saved variable under this paragraph; no fabricated no-op classifier or SAVE-on-constant control.

That declarator specifies a variable with explicit initialization. PENDING definition/use binding to 19.6.3 and the initial-state effects below; executable redefinition and default initialization do not count as another explicit declaration initializer.

DATA is an alternative explicit-initialization route, subject to the original exception and 8.6.7 conditions. PENDING finite canonical source-use of INTEGER scalar DATA, disjoint array/substring DATA, an eligible non-default-initialized derived object and an INTEGER pointer's NULL/target initialization. Keep prior typing/array properties, C880 exclusions, constant designators and value-list cardinality. No new DATA wrapper or no-op S requirement.

The DATA alternative carries the exclusion for a variable of derived type for which default initialization is specified. PENDING source contrast: a complete nonpointer type with one default-initialized INTEGER component versus the same type with only that component initializer removed, with a fully specifying constant DATA constructor in both. This is prose, not a mandatory diagnostic policy. The nonpointer wording of 8.6.7p2 does not by itself waive 8.4's qualification for other roles; a pointer of a default-initialized derived type is deliberately not claimed as a valid DATA control pending independent cross-role review.
The specified initial-value interpretation is conditional on the equals constant-expression form; arrow initialization is treated separately in p2.
Original PDF119 lines19-20 distinguishes initial disassociation from association with the given initial-data-target, without supplying a target value or allocation.
Original PDF119 lines21-22 contains a COMMON-qualified SAVE implication and permission to confirm it explicitly. The permission is not a second no-op effect.

PENDING source-use/positive-control variants of the real retention plan with one confirming SAVE attribute or one named SAVE statement. Implied plus explicit confirmation is not duplicate explicit specification under C815. Retain C893's no-list restrictions, C1108's required list in BLOCK and the fact that an outer SAVE does not reach local BLOCK entities; no separate executable permission classifier.

requirements.title: A declaration constant initializer establishes the initial value
requirements.source: 8.4 p1, physical PDF119, printed105, lines13-16, with lines11-13 context
requirements.definition: For the eligible non-PARAMETER variable with equals constant-expression initialization, the variable is initially defined from that expression. When needed, intrinsic-assignment conversion supplies a value agreeing with the variable's type, type parameters and shape. This is an initial-state interpretation, not a repeated executable assignment on every procedure entry, a pointer-association operation or a waiver of constant-expression and receiver conditions.

pending.scalar-integer-and-logical: PENDING runtime first-use checks before any executable assignment to the initialized variables: INTEGER values-3 and7, and default LOGICAL true and false. Each has a direct independent literal/branch observer; no PARAMETER receiver, empty compile control or undefined payload.
pending.integer-kind-conversion: PENDING two runtime directions between default INTEGER and SELECTED_INT_KIND(18), with small values-3 and7 that fit both. Original7.4.3.1 guarantees a range18 method;16.9.181 selects it and16.9.110 preserves an INTEGER value. The selected method may be the default. Never require distinct numeric KIND identifiers, byte widths or conversion of arbitrary kind codes into the selected representation.
pending.character-length-conversion: PENDING default-CHARACTER variables initialized from constant strings: truncate ABCD to length2 with expected AB; pad AB to length5 with expected AB followed by three blanks; and initialize a length-zero entity. Check LEN independently as well as defined characters, because padded relational comparison alone could hide a wrong length. No assumed source encoding or nondefault kind.
pending.scalar-array-expansion: PENDING ordinary nonpointer INTEGER arrays of explicit shapes3 and2-by-2 with scalar initializer7. Check their defined extents and every element against independent7. This is intrinsic initialization of arrays, never value broadcasting into a pointer or permission to initialize an ALLOCATABLE entity.
pending.array-values: PENDING INTEGER rank-one variable of extent3 initialized by the constant vector[2,3,5], with independent element checks before executable assignment, plus an extent-zero typed-empty initialization whose defined SIZE is0 and whose nonexistent elements are never read. SIZE of the declared data object observes that variable; it is not a proof of the constructor expression's rank.
pending.derived-explicit-override: PENDING complete derived type with one ordinary INTEGER component defaulted to1, and an ordinary variable explicitly initialized by the constant constructor supplying7. Check the component's initial value7, not its default1. Every component is specified and constant; no defined assignment, hidden allocatable state or private inaccessible component. Existing component-default witnesses keep7.5.4.6 ownership and do not become this declaration effect.
pending.enum-and-enumeration-values: PENDING a small runtime corpus with three separate roles: ordinary INTEGER initialized from an unnamed ENUM enumerator explicitly valued4; one named enum type with its own enumerators valued2/4, variables initialized from the latter enumerator and a constructor using the former, expecting INT values4/2; and a two-member enumeration type with a variable initialized from its first enumerator, expecting ordinal1. The declared enumerator values establish the needed enum representability. Use complete prior definitions and fresh names; no KIND-of-enum, cross-type equality, unsigned extreme or representation oracle.
pending.numeric-representation-source-use: PENDING finite source/oracle qualification for REAL initialized from INTEGER7 and COMPLEX from INTEGER-3 through Table10.9, together with direct and typed-array BOZ consumer roles. REAL/CMPLX result rules do not establish a universal bit pattern or arbitrary exact/tolerance oracle; derive a justified independent finite outcome before an effect case. Retain unresolved value/representation work pending, not compile-only. Direct declaration INTEGER/REAL BOZ permission does not extend to REAL DATA initialization, whose8.6.7p11 receiver is INTEGER.

requirements.oracle: Initial defined scalar, character and array values are compared with independently derived finite literals; parameter/shape checks accompany values where necessary. The conversion semantics come from the original standard, never a second execution of the same conversion or compiler consensus. Type-family plans retain their specific conformance and constant-expression premises.
requirements.oracle_limitation: All facets remain pending. No real/complex exactness, floating tolerance, optional kind, native representation or REAL BOZ value is invented. C808 excludes dummy/result/automatic/ALLOCATABLE and the specified COMMON contexts; C811 distinguishes equals from pointer initialization. A successful declaration is not execution evidence, and initial values are not reimposed after every executable redefinition.

requirements.title: A variable or part has at most one explicit initialization
requirements.definition: The same variable or part of it cannot receive explicit initialization more than once in a program. Entity identity and overlap matter, not just spelling or equality of supplied values. Disjoint parts and distinct variables do not become repetitions merely because they occur in several statements or share a local name. Executable assignment and the permitted overriding of default initialization are different mechanisms.

pending.declaration-and-data-contrast: PENDING source-only complete ordinary INTEGER declaration x=7 followed by DATA x/9/, with a same-value7 variant to separate occurrence count from value disagreement. The minimal repair deletes only the DATA initialization. No runtime of either nonconforming source and no mandatory diagnostic expectation without a separately authorized policy.
pending.repeated-data-contrast: PENDING source-only scalar INTEGER declaration with two DATA initializations of that scalar; repair removes the second DATA statement. Both value expressions and all DATA eligibility conditions otherwise hold. The repaired compile admission preserves the entity rather than hiding the condition by renaming or dropping it.
pending.whole-and-part-contrast: PENDING source-only ordinary array initialized as a whole in its type declaration and again at one constant-index element in DATA. Delete only that DATA statement. This distinguishes whole/part overlap from legal disjoint subobject initialization; no shape, constant-index or pointer defect may substitute.
pending.overlapping-subparts-contrast: PENDING two finite source-only DATA families: one repeated element of an explicit two-element INTEGER array and overlapping constant substrings1:2 and2:3 of a CHARACTER length4 variable. Focused repairs move the second initializer to the distinct second element or substring3:4. All intervals are valid and every initializer has the correct receiver shape/length.
pending.disjoint-parts-admission: PENDING compile positive controls with separate DATA initialization of both elements of an INTEGER array and disjoint substrings1:2/3:4 of CHARACTER length4. All observed parts would be defined; these are source-conforming admissions, not new initialization-order or evaluation-order effects.
pending.pointer-initialization-contrast: PENDING source-only scalar INTEGER POINTER with declaration =>NULL() and a second DATA initialization using NULL() or an eligible saved static target. Delete only the DATA initialization. Keep target SAVE/TARGET, type/rank and bare-null-init premises; do not confuse repeated initialization of the pointer with initialization of its target.
pending.distinct-entity-admission: PENDING complete separate procedures with different local INTEGER variables that happen to have the same name, each initialized once. Their identity is scope-specific; compile admission only. No global textual duplicate-name policy or clone of existing canonical cases.
pending.program-scope-source-use: PENDING finite whole-program source-use across declaration and DATA routes, including named-COMMON/BLOCK DATA. Preserve14.3p4's separate ban on specifying the same named common block in multiple BLOCK DATA units; such an example is not an isolated local diagnostic. Repeated procedure entry and ordinary executable redefinition are not additional explicit initializer occurrences.

requirements.oracle: Otherwise-conforming finite source contrasts with focused minimal repairs and positive admissions. A future diagnostic execution needs a genuine independent numbered causal owner or an explicitly authorized policy; the prose restriction alone does not require a compiler to reject or report.
requirements.oracle_limitation: No policy, invalid runtime, undefined-value trap or byte-overlap model is authored. A future reporter must identify the actual initialized entity/part and repeated-initialization relation at the relevant statements; generic duplicate-type, DATA-count, wrong-kind, missing-END or unsupported-facility errors cannot be credited. No imposed order among permitted independent initializations.

requirements.title: An initialized array has its shape specified in the permitted context
requirements.definition: For an array variable being explicitly initialized, its shape is specified in the type declaration or in a preceding attribute specification statement in the same scoping unit. This does not permit shape inference from an initializer as a replacement for a required variable declaration, retroactive repair by a later attribute statement, or a shape specification for a different entity in another scope. DATA has additional prior-property requirements.

pending.entity-shape-admission: PENDING complete INTEGER array declaration with its own extent2 and constant initializer[2,3]. Positive compile admission; C808 and8.2p4 must hold. It is an ordinary array variable, not an implied-shape named constant or ALLOCATABLE initializer.
pending.statement-dimension-admission: PENDING INTEGER,DIMENSION(2) array variable with the same constant initializer and no conflicting entity shape. Reuse the admitted source context where possible; it does not by itself prove the constructor expression's rank.
pending.prior-attribute-admission: PENDING a DIMENSION statement establishing extent2 before the one INTEGER type declaration carrying initialization, in the same procedure scoping unit. Prior array properties and later explicit typing must be valid under8.6.8/8.7; there is only one explicit DIMENSION specification.
pending.late-attribute-source-contrast: PENDING source-only reversed ordering of that DIMENSION statement and initialized type declaration, repaired solely by moving DIMENSION before the declaration. Audit the resulting scalar/array interpretation and8.2p4 interaction before any diagnostic policy; a different rank/shape error is not automatic corroboration of the order rule.
pending.same-scope-source-use: PENDING canonical source comparison of a genuine prior specification for the same entity and a homonymous declaration in another procedure. Different names/scopes do not establish this variable's shape. Keep any negative documentary until its entity identity and causal isolation are established; no phantom source-use graph credit.
pending.data-order-source-use: PENDING finite canonical DATA contexts with prior type/array declarations, contrasted with later establishment of array properties under8.6.7p3. Preserve implicit-typing confirmation and constant-designator conditions. A typed array constructor or a fixed-rank receiver cannot repair missing declaration prerequisites or serve as a constructor-rank oracle.

requirements.oracle: Conforming compile admissions and original-source order/identity contrasts. No runtime effect or mandatory diagnostic is inferred from syntactic admission under this unnumbered restriction.
requirements.oracle_limitation: The late-specification contrast may intersect other shape/type rules and is not claimed as an implemented isolated negative. No new diagnostic policy, assumed shape inference, pointer broadcasting, RANK([...]) probe or fixed-rank-destination proxy is introduced.

requirements.title: Pointer initialization establishes the specified association status
requirements.definition: A null-init establishes initial disassociation; an initial-data-target establishes initial association with that target. These effects do not allocate anything, define an arbitrary target value, or authorize a target incompatible with the pointer. The standalone declaration-initialization role is distinct from component default initialization and from the initial-proc-target route for procedure pointers.

pending.null-scalar: PENDING runtime ordinary INTEGER POINTER initialized by bare intrinsic NULL(). Its first observer requires .NOT.ASSOCIATED(pointer). No target value is read, ALLOCATED is not applied to a pointer, and no undefined-initial-association control is substituted.
pending.null-array: PENDING deferred-shape INTEGER POINTER initialized by NULL(), with an independent first association-status check. Do not inspect its unavailable bounds, shape, SIZE or elements. Add a separate deferred-LEN CHARACTER pointer status context only without querying its unavailable length.
pending.saved-scalar-target: PENDING runtime scalar pointer initially associated with a saved nonallocatable noncoindexed INTEGER TARGET defined to11. First require ASSOCIATED(pointer,target) and value11; define target to13 and require pointer value13. This distinguishes association from a one-time value copy without comparing addresses or representations.
pending.saved-array-and-element-targets: PENDING same-rank whole-array initialization and a scalar pointer initialized to a constant-index element of a saved defined INTEGER TARGET array. Check status before payload and independently require values2/3/5. Include a separate saved zero-size INTEGER target with one-argument ASSOCIATED true and defined SIZE0, never an element read or two-argument ASSOCIATED-true expectation. Preserve C770 constant designators and C812 rank/type/parameter rules; no vector subscript, scalar broadcast or invented association-bound convention.
pending.deferred-character-target: PENDING deferred-LEN default-CHARACTER pointer initialized to a saved TARGET of fixed length3 and defined text ABC; after association is confirmed, require LEN3 and the characters. A separate length-zero saved target uses one-argument ASSOCIATED true and LEN0, not two-argument target-identity truth for a zero-sized storage sequence. Both are established associations, not inquiries on disassociated deferred-length objects or assumed parameters requiring NULL MOLD.
pending.data-versus-procedure-source-use: PENDING finite source-use of declaration R805/R806/C813, DATA8.6.7p9, component-default7.5.4.6p3-p5 and procedure-pointer15.4.3.6p6/R1517. Each retains its owner. General NULL(MOLD=...) elsewhere is not bare null-init; procedure initial-proc-target and its SAVE implication are not silently imported into this initial-data-target effect.

requirements.oracle: Defined association-status inquiries followed only where legal by defined target/parameter observations, with an independent target-update alias check. C770 static lifetime and C812 compatibility are prerequisites, not results inferred from compiler acceptance.
requirements.oracle_limitation: No negative twin, unavailable pointer inquiry, dangling target, numeric address or allocation claim. A saved pointer does not extend an unsaved target's lifetime. ASSOCIATED(pointer,target) has additional nonzero-size/storage-sequence premises and is not interchangeable with the one-argument status inquiry. Existing C770 and component-default programs remain unchanged and cannot be relabelled as newly executed standalone declaration effects.

requirements.title: Explicit initialization outside COMMON implies SAVE
requirements.definition: Explicit initialization of a variable outside COMMON gives it SAVE; an explicit specification may confirm this implication. SAVE's retention semantics and target-lifetime exceptions remain those of8.5.16 and Clause19. The COMMON exclusion does not assert that a COMMON object can never have SAVE from another route. PARAMETER entities, component default initialization and procedure-pointer initialization retain their different categories and defining rules.

pending.subprogram-retention: PENDING runtime procedure with local INTEGER initialized to7, no explicit SAVE, and a defined OUT observer. First call returns7 and increments the local; second returns8. Do not overwrite the local before observation. Finite confirming-SAVE variants may share this real retention corpus, with exactly one explicit attribute or named statement; no empty permission program.
pending.block-retention: PENDING two executions of the same BLOCK with local INTEGER initialized to7. Copy its defined value to a host observer, increment it, and require successive observations7/8 plus an exact observation count. This is one saved construct entity across executions, not two different BLOCK declarations. C1108/C1109 and processor-dependent specification-expression ordering remain respected.
pending.data-part-retention: PENDING local ordinary INTEGER array of extent2 with only element1 explicitly initialized to7 by DATA. On the first call define element2 to13 before any read, observe7/13 and change element1 to8. On the second call independently observe8/13. The whole named variable obtains SAVE through8.6.7p4, but an uninitialized part is not thereby initially defined.
pending.saved-pointer-live-target: PENDING scalar INTEGER pointer initialized toNULL() and thus saved outside COMMON. First invocation observes disassociation and pointer-assigns it to a separately saved, defined TARGET11; a later invocation observes the retained association/value before any new assignment. The target remains alive. Never replace this with a pointer to an unsaved local or query an undefined association after return.
pending.allocated-component-retention: PENDING ordinary nonallocatable derived variable explicitly initialized by a complete constant constructor with an unallocated INTEGER allocatable component via contextual NULL. First verify unallocated status, allocate the component and define values11/13; next invocation requires allocated status and both retained values. C808 excludes initialization of an ALLOCATABLE entity, not this ordinary container. Do not read unallocated data or add coarrays/finalizers.
pending.common-and-implicit-save-source-use: PENDING finite source-use of named COMMON initialized in one valid BLOCK DATA unit, SAVE on the common block rather than its member, and main/module/submodule implicit SAVE. Preserve8.5.16p3/p4 and19.6.6's active-scoping-unit condition for named COMMON. No read of an unsaved undefined COMMON value can prove the absence of an implication. An outer no-list SAVE does not reach a BLOCK's local entities.
pending.default-versus-explicit-source-use: PENDING source-use comparison with the byte-preserved S7_5_4_6_006_valid__initialization_value_local program, whose component default initialization is reapplied on its local-entry contexts. Default initialization alone does not imply SAVE. The new explicit-initialization retention plan observes7/8 instead of asserting reinitialization; existing component-default cases keep their original IDs, roles, inputs and7.5.4.6 ownership.

requirements.oracle: Multiple executions with exact independently expected retained values/status, not a successful single call or a storage-address comparison. All observations occur while the relevant data and association states are defined; the finite program counts expose omitted second visits.
requirements.oracle_limitation: All plans remain pending and genuine runs. Do not infer physical memory clearing or demand a trap for an unsaved variable; do not preserve a pointer's status by ignoring the target-undefinition exceptions at RETURN/BLOCK exit. DATA/default-derived qualifications remain recorded separately. Explicit initialization is incompatible with the excluded C808/C880 entities; permitted explicit SAVE confirmation is not a second initialization.

Exact entity/constant-expression, local-entry, DATA/default-initialization, conversion, overlap/shape, association and SAVE conditions and all53finite pending plans are preserved.
